name: Metoclopramide
executiveSummary: D2 prokinetic and antiemetic. Adult 10 mg PO/IV every 6–8 h (usual European short-course max 30 mg/day). Pediatrics 0.1–0.2 mg/kg/dose (max 0.5 mg/kg/day) — high extrapyramidal risk.
indications:
## Indications

- Nausea and vomiting (including postoperative and migraine/ED-associated).
- Delayed gastric emptying / prokinetic use in selected settings.
- High-dose CINV only in historical/specialist regimens (prefer 5-HT3).

## Precautions

- **Extrapyramidal effects** (children and young adults) — avoid prolonged use; many labels limit to **≤ 5 days**.
- Contraindicated in GI obstruction/perforation, pheochromocytoma, uncontrolled epilepsy, Parkinson disease.
- Reduce dose in renal failure. Antimuscarinics/opioids antagonize GI effect; antipsychotics ↑ EPS.

> EMA/AEMPS: adults max **0.5 mg/kg/day** and generally **10 mg × 3/day**; children only if other options fail.

adulto.presentation: Ampoules 10 mg/2 mL; tablets 10 mg; drops 5 mg/mL.
adulto.dose: Usual: **10 mg PO, IM, or slow IV every 6–8 h** (frequent max **30 mg/day** / **0.5 mg/kg/day**). Postoperative: **10 mg** every 6–8 h PRN. CINV (older regimens): **1–2 mg/kg/dose** IV every 2–4 h for a few doses — now reserved; prefer ondansetron.
adulto.administration: Slow IV ≥ 3 min or infusion ≥ 15 min diluted in NS (0.2–5 mg/mL). No rapid bolus.
adulto.notes: Y-site incompatible with cephalothin and sodium bicarbonate.

pediatrico.presentation: Drops 2 mg/mL; tablets 10 mg; ampoules 5 mg/mL.
pediatrico.dose: Nausea: **0.1–0.15 mg/kg/dose** PO/IV every 6–8 h (card range **0.4–0.8 mg/kg/day** divided; do not exceed **0.5 mg/kg/day** per many labels). Postoperative: **0.1–0.2 mg/kg/dose** every 6–8 h. > 14 years: as adult (**10 mg** every 6–8 h).
pediatrico.administration: PO/IV/IM. Slow IV or infused ≥ 15 min.
pediatrico.notes: Stop if dystonia; have diphenhydramine/biperiden available per protocol.

neonatal.dose: NNU only: orientative **0.1 mg/kg** per protocol — not routine.
neonatal.notes: Disproportionate neurologic risk; avoid unless explicit indication.

stability:
## Stability

- Ampoule: use after opening; discard remainder.
- Dilution: prepare extemporaneously.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Somnolence, restlessness, diarrhea, depression. EPS (dystonia, akathisia), seizures, neuroleptic malignant syndrome (rare).
